blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The full eradication of violence against children by 2030 is “unlikely” to happen amid the efforts of countries to support and protect children who have been victims of different forms of violence, the World Health Organization (WHO) said on Wednesday. During the sidelines of the 2nd Global Ministerial Conference on Ending Violence Against Children, WHO Director of the Department of Health, Promotion and Prevention Etienne Krug was asked of the level of confidence in achieving Sustainable Development 16.2 or the target to eliminate all forms of violence against children by 2030.
